Overview

Noakhali is a city in Chittagong with a population of 150,000. A district town in southeastern Bangladesh known for its agriculture, fisheries, and the Noakhali genocide memorial. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
